sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.P.SANDESH  ORAL JUDGMENT

The learned counsel for the appellant files a memo seeking permission of this Court to withdraw the appeal on the ground that the appellant has undergone and completed the entire sentence imposed by the learned Sessions Judge.
The memo is taken on record.
In view of the said memo, the learned counsel for the appellant is permitted to withdraw the appeal.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
